name: Weak Opponent
notes: Militia, hired thugs, city watch. Extras have only three health levels and die instantly if knocked below Incapacitated by lethal damage. Damage is not rolled against them: every three dice remaining after soak deals one automatic health level (nine or more dice incapacitates outright), and any remainder of one or two dice is rolled normally. Extras do not count 10s as two successes. Exalted p.241.

name: Competent Opponent
notes: Trained troops, professional legbreakers, city guard. Three health levels only; damage is not rolled against extras (three dice past soak = one automatic health level) and they do not count 10s as two successes. Exalted p.241.

name: Elite Opponent
notes: Crack troops, professional assassins, praetorian guard. Three health levels only; damage is not rolled against extras (three dice past soak = one automatic health level) and they do not count 10s as two successes. Exalted p.241.

name: Typical Citizen
notes: Almost always an extra. Exalted p.276.

name: Heretic
notes: Almost always an extra. A religious outcast. Wears a buff jacket. Exalted p.277.

name: Partisan
notes: Almost always an extra. A political outcast fighting a guerilla war. Wears a buff jacket. Exalted p.277.

name: Bandit
notes: Almost always an extra. As a criminal, but working the countryside rather than a city. Wears a buff jacket. Exalted p.277.

name: Criminal
notes: Almost always an extra. A social outcast profiting from the current situation. Wears a buff jacket. Criminals have no Archery Ability, so the self bow line does not apply to them. Exalted p.277.

name: Militia
notes: Almost always an extra. The average militiaman: patrols streets and markets and makes up the bulk of conscript armies. Wears a buff jacket. Exalted p.278.

name: Infantry
notes: Trained for battle rather than police duty. Wears a reinforced buff jacket and carries a target shield, which together give -3 mobility and +1 difficulty to attack them. Exalted p.278.

name: Elite Troops
notes: Often an extra. Career soldiers, often raised from childhood for military service. Wears lamellar armour and carries a target shield, which together give -3 mobility and +1 difficulty to attack them. Exalted p.278.

name: Merchant Prince
notes: A Guild syndic's delegate in a caravan. Wears a reinforced buff jacket. Exalted p.279.

name: Wyld Barbarian
notes: Usually an extra. Wears pangolin scale armour (a buff jacket) and carries a target shield, together -2 mobility and +1 difficulty to attack. Exalted p.281-282.

name: Wyld Shaman
notes: Often an extra. Generally quite mad; usually has at least one affliction and two poxes. Printed soak is 4L/8B, which includes scars and tattoos worth 4L/4B — there is no catalogue armour for those, so the whole figure is recorded as natural soak. Exalted p.282-283.

name: Wolfman
notes: Usually an extra. A commonly occurring beastman of the Northeast, with the afflictions Fangs and the poxes Fur, Eye Color (wolf-like, can see in the dark), Hair Color (red wolf-pelt), Acute Smell and Large. Printed soak is 6L/10B from a battered chain hauberk (-3 mobility penalty); recorded here as natural soak because the battered version is not the catalogue item. Exalted p.283.

name: Buck-Ogre
notes: Probably not an extra. A two-headed scourge of the northeast Threshold, with the poxes Eye Color (+2 on visual Awareness rolls) and Hair Color (Elk Pelt), the afflictions Huge and Tusks/Horns, and the blights Armored Hide, Beast Form and Multiple Heads. Wields a great axe in each hand and must split its dice pool normally to act twice. Printed soak is 9L/14B, hide plus salvaged armour equal to a reinforced buff jacket (5L/6B, -2 mobility); recorded whole as natural soak. Exalted p.284-285.

attacks.name: Great Axe
attacks.note: one axe in each hand; must split its dice pool normally to act twice

name: Common Zombie
notes: Wounds inflicted by a zombie are extraordinarily likely to become infected: the difficulty of the Stamina + Resistance roll to resist infection from a zombie-inflicted wound is increased by 2. Characters fighting zombies hand-to-hand must succeed at a Stamina + Resistance roll at difficulty 2 each turn or suffer -2 on all dice pools that turn from nausea; the stench loses its impact after several encounters. Virtues are not applicable — a zombie never fails Valor rolls and never succeeds at any other rolls. Exalted p.299.

attacks.name: Fist
attacks.note: wounds likely to infect: +2 difficulty to resist

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.note: wounds likely to infect: +2 difficulty to resist

name: Spine Chain
notes: Several dozen corpses cleaved at the midriff and sewn into a long chain. Health levels are per link: one each of -0, -1 and -2 for every link, so the track here is one link only — add three boxes per additional link. When the first link is damaged or the spine is severed, the closest link pulls the stitching loose from the damaged portion, discards it and assumes control. Breaking apart and joining with other spine chains takes too much time to occur in combat. Virtues are not applicable — never fails Valor rolls, never succeeds at any other rolls. Exalted p.300.

attacks.name: Harness Sideswipe
attacks.note: wounds likely to infect: +2 difficulty to resist

name: Hungry Ghost
notes: Often an extra. Naturally material, rising from its corpse at nightfall and dematerialising at sunrise (at no Essence cost) to sleep in its body. A hungry ghost must be at its body by sunrise or the sun's rays will blast it to ash, and it cannot cross an unbroken line of salt or germinated grain. Exalted p.300-301.

name: War Ghost
notes: Usually an extra. Wears field soldier's armour of black iron and carries a shield (chain hauberk, -3 mobility penalty, +1 difficulty to attack). For less violent ghosts use the Typical Citizen, save that one of their Virtues is 3 and they have an Essence Pool of 41. Exalted p.301.

name: Nemissary
notes: Usually an extra. A ghost that possesses and animates corpses other than its own, riding them for several days at a stretch. Its attacks are infectious like a zombie's, adding +2 to the difficulty of the Stamina + Resistance roll to resist infection. Wears a breastplate (-1 mobility penalty). Exalted p.301.
powers: Cunning Thief, Measure the Wind, Possession

name: Zephyr
notes: An air elemental: elusive, whimsical, and an excellent scout, messenger or assassin. Its natural state is the physical one, so it pays to DEmaterialize rather than to materialize. Printed soak 5L/7B includes an air barrier worth 4L/4B. Exalted p.298.
charms: Cunning Thief, Dematerialize, Essence Bite, Measure the Wind, Principle of Motion, Words of Power
powers: Elemental Powers: Dragon's Suspire, Element's Domain, Enshroud, Mobility, Rejuvenation

name: Austrech
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). A flightless runner some seven feet tall, with a bone-cracking hooked beak. Known to eat its own eggs and offspring. Exalted p.316-317.

name: Bear
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). No dodge is printed for the bear. Their strongest sense is smell; their weakest is sight. Exalted p.316-317.

name: Boar
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). A surly woodland hog, fierce and short-tempered. Exalted p.316-317.

name: Camel
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). A foul-tempered herbivore and a common mount in the South. Exalted p.316-317.

name: Coral Snake
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). Nocturnal, up to five feet long, red, white and black banded. Sought after by assassins for its venom. Exalted p.316-317.

name: Dog (War)
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). Keen senses of smell and hearing make them excellent hunters and trackers. Exalted p.316-317.

name: Giant Wolf Spider
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). Two feet high and five feet long, hiding in trees or deep jungle burrows. Not poisonous. Exalted p.316-317.

name: Great Cat
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). Superb hunters, up to five feet at the shoulder. Difficult to train, but they can be domesticated. Exalted p.316-317.

name: Horse
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). The riding animal of mortal society, with many subspecies bred for purity, speed and loyalty. Exalted p.316-317.

name: Horse (War)
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). Exalted p.316-317.

name: Hybroc
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). A scaled bird with a 50-75 foot wingspan, able to carry off a horse. Hybrocs are control rating 5 to ride; attempts to domesticate them have failed so far. Exalted p.316-317.

name: Ichneumon Hunter
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). A giant wasp a metre long, whose ovipositor deposits eggs into a host. Emerging larvae inflict one level of lethal damage per day, no soak allowed; the larvae may be killed through herbal remedies. Exalted p.316-317.

name: Mammoth
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). Fourteen feet at the shoulder. Guild caravans use mammoths for transport; hunters seek them for meat and ivory. Exalted p.316-317.

name: Mospid
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). A small scaled bird favoured by nobility as a sport hunter, capable of quick, tight aerial manoeuvres. Exalted p.316-317.

name: Omen Dogs
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). Exalted p.316-317.

name: Raiton
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). Printed as "Athletic 3" in the table; read as Athletics. Exalted p.316-317.

name: River Dragon
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). Exalted p.316-317.

name: Sand Swimmers
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). No Dodge/Soak figures are printed for this row. Exalted p.316-317.

name: Siaka
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). Exalted p.316-317.

name: Strix
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). Exalted p.316-317.

name: Squid
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). Exalted p.316-317.

name: Tyrant Lizard
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). Exalted p.316-317.

name: Yeddim
notes: Unless otherwise stated, beasts have Intelligence 1, Perception 2 and Wits 3, and their Attack value is used for both attacks and parries (Exalted p.317). A giant pack mammal; Guild caravans use them to draw their Conestogas. Its Trample attack has no printed statistics — see the attack's own note. Exalted p.316-317.

attacks.name: Trample
attacks.note: no attack values are printed — the Attack column reads "-2x3/-4/I", which is health-level notation, not Speed/Accuracy/Damage. Human's ruling 2026-08-01: a misprint, almost certainly the health track's own continuation typeset into the wrong column. Nothing was guessed

name: Dynasty Noble
notes: A Dragon-Blooded lord of the Realm's vice trade — a Dynast who has fallen far from the warrior ideal and rules through money, blackmail and favours. Attack: Charms only. Relies on a retinue of guards equivalent to elite troops. Terrestrial Exalted are never extras. Exalted p.306-307.

abilities.name: Linguistics
abilities.specialties: Native: High Realm; Guild Cant, Riverspeak

charms: Still remembers the military Charms he once knew but is long too obese to use them; relies on his honeyed tongue instead. Assume Charms that increase any of his Social Abilities at a cost of one mote per two dice. Can spend 5 motes to double his Socialize or Presence for the rest of the scene. Can reroll failed Presence and Larceny attempts at a cost of 3 motes. For 3 motes per roll and a Willpower, can reroll any Presence roll until he succeeds. Has a Combo combining the doubled Presence pool and the reroll — useful only for emergencies. Also possesses minor healing abilities, due to his Wood aspect.

name: Ambitious Young Officer
notes: The book's own words: "could be any ambitious young Dragon-Blooded warrior. Such foes typically travel in groups of two to six, usually leading detachments of elite troops. Terrestrial Exalted are never extras." Carries a jade reaver daiklave. Wears articulated plate with a target shield. Exalted p.307-308.
charms: A large number of military Charms, focused mainly on his Melee. He can increase his Melee Ability at a cost of 1 mote per two dice, or spend 5 motes to double it for the whole scene. He can reroll failed Melee rolls for 3 motes. He can also increase his Awareness, Performance and Medicine Abilities at a cost of one mote per two dice. Roll his Dexterity + Archery to throw bolts of fire, with a range in yards equal to 10 times his Essence; for every 3 motes he spends, the bolt does lethal damage equal to his Essence, and extra successes add to the damage as normal. He cannot spend more motes powering this attack than (his Stamina x 3).

name: Bronze Faction Functionary
notes: A Sidereal agent of the Bronze Faction: assassin and executioner first, administrator second, charged with observing events, manipulating local politics and carrying out the Solar Purge. Fights in the most efficient fashion available and prefers to slay her targets in single combat, but puts her mission first. Exalted p.311-312.

abilities.name: Linguistics
abilities.specialties: Native: Forest-tongue; High Realm, Old Realm, Riverspeak

charms: Adds dice to her Melee and Archery attacks as a supplemental action, to Presence, Performance, Endurance and Survival rolls as a simple action, and to Dodge as a reflexive action. Can lower the difficulty of her Melee and Archery attacks on a per-roll basis to as low as 4, at a cost of 2 motes for each point by which she reduces the difficulty; can reduce the difficulty of all her Melee rolls during the scene by 1 for 10 motes and 1 Willpower; can reduce the difficulty on Dodge rolls as a reflexive action at 1 mote per point. For 10 motes, 2 Willpower and 1 health level she can make a perfect strike — an attack in which all her dice come up successes — which she holds in a Combo with her two Dodge Charms and the Charms that add dice to Melee and lower their difficulty. She has a Charm that allows her to roll half her Essence (rounded up) and take as many extra attacks during that turn as she rolls successes. She can triple her jumping distance for a single leap at a cost of 1 mote. She can increase her lethal and bashing soaks by an amount equal to her Essence for a scene for 5 motes, and against a single attack for 2 motes; these two Charms stack.
spells: Terrestrial and Celestial Circle sorcery, and a large number of spells.

attacks.name: Starmetal Long Powerbow
attacks.note: usually loaded with frog-crotch arrows, which double the target's lethal soak

name: Deathknight
notes: An Abyssal Exalted in a Deathlord's service, sent to study the cities of the living and report on their weaknesses. A Melee specialist. Printed soak is 7L/10B from a reinforced buff jacket (5L/6B, -2 mobility penalty), but he always has the Abyssal equivalent of Front-Line Warrior's Stamina active and so suffers NO mobility penalty and no fatigue from his armour — which is why the armour is recorded as natural soak here and the dodge pool is left unreduced. Exalted p.314-315.
charms: A Melee specialist — knows the Abyssal versions of most Melee Charms, as well as the Abyssal equivalents of Dipping Swallow Defense and Iron Kettle Body. The latter Charm does not increase soak, but instead decreases the damage the attacker does before soak is applied, and can totally dissipate the effects of weak blows.
spells: Terrestrial Circle and Celestial Circle sorcery; knows Incomparable Body Arsenal as well as a number of Terrestrial spells.

name: Hruggha
notes: Hruggha are squat, filthy Darkbrood raiders of the deep Demesnes, attacking in swarms and taking prisoners back to their spawning pits to infect. Their foul stone and crystal weapons add 2 to the difficulty of resisting infection. (CH6 pp.284-285)

name: Cephalid
notes: Cephalids are the elite Darkbrood warriors of the deep warrens — fast, inky-skinned horrors with a deadly bite and grasping tentacles. The second attack block is their awakened/defensive mode. (CH6 pp.286-288)

name: Vodak
notes: The Vodak is a Labyrinthine horror, a colossal shapeless mass of protean flesh with pseudopods that crush for 30L. It has a body of 200 -0 health levels and no dodge pool. (CH6 pp.289-292)
